description: Frontend: add a per-game accordion on the series detail page that lazy-fetches /game?gamePk= on expand and renders the inning R/H/E table, W/L/S pitchers, venue, and an optional highlights link. On a fetch failure (or an 'unavailable' response) keep showing the existing final score (criterion 2). The inning table scrolls horizontally on mobile without breaking layout (criterion 3). Full EN/JA i18n, accessible accordion, with component + e2e tests. Depends on FEAT-002 (shared GameDetailResponse type) and does not depend on FEAT-003 at build time (frontend only needs the shared type + the /game HTTP path).
steps: Add `getGameDetail(gamePk: number): Promise<GameDetailResponse>` to frontend/src/api.ts using the existing requestJson<T> wrapper: `requestJson<GameDetailResponse>(\`/game?gamePk=${encodeURIComponent(gamePk)}\`)`. Import GameDetailResponse from @mlb/shared. Unlike getBracket there is no seed fallback; let requestJson throw ApiError on failure so the component can catch and fall back to the final score (criterion 2).

Add i18n keys to frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts (both the key union and the en + ja records) for all new labels: detail.game.expand (e.g. 'Show game detail' / '試合詳細を表示'), detail.game.collapse ('Hide game detail' / '試合詳細を隠す'), detail.game.loading ('Loading game detail…' / '試合詳細を読み込み中…'), detail.game.error ('Game detail is unavailable; showing the final score.' / '試合詳細を取得できませんでした。最終スコアを表示します。'), detail.game.inning ('Inning' / 'イニング'), detail.game.runs/hits/errors short headers R/H/E (localized aria/full labels: 'Runs'/'得点', 'Hits'/'安打', 'Errors'/'失策'), detail.game.total ('Total'/'合計' or use R/H/E totals row label), detail.game.winPitcher ('Win' / '勝利投手'), detail.game.losePitcher ('Loss' / '敗戦投手'), detail.game.savePitcher ('Save' / 'セーブ投手'), detail.game.venue ('Venue' / '球場'), detail.game.highlights ('Highlights' / 'ハイライト'), detail.game.away ('Away'/'ビジター'), detail.game.home ('Home'/'ホーム'). Follow the existing detail.* key style; reuse teamAbbr/teamName for team labels.

In frontend/src/pages/SeriesDetailPage.tsx convert the DetailGame <li> into an accordion item. Keep the existing final-score line ALWAYS rendered (it is the fallback). Add a toggle button with aria-expanded + aria-controls pointing at a collapsible panel region (follow the accessible toggle pattern used by SeriesCard's games-toggle: aria-expanded flips, label switches between expand/collapse). The panel starts collapsed; on first expand, lazy-call getGameDetail(game.gamePk) and manage per-game state: idle -> loading -> ready(GameDetailResponse 'ok') | fallback(error or 'unavailable'). Do not fetch until the user expands (criterion 1 benefits: fewer calls; the backend caches).

Render the detail panel when ready+ok: a venue line (detail.game.venue), the W/L/S pitchers (detail.game.winPitcher/losePitcher/savePitcher, omit a line when the field is absent e.g. no save), an optional highlights link (anchor to highlight.url with rel='noopener noreferrer' target='_blank', shown only when highlight present), and the inning R/H/E TABLE. The table: a <table> with a scope='col' header row (Team, each inning number as a column header, then R, H, E totals columns) and two body rows (away, home) with scope='row' on the team cell. Wrap the table in a horizontally-scrollable container `<div className="detail__linescore-scroll">` so it scrolls on narrow screens.

On loading show detail.game.loading (role='status'); on error or an 'unavailable' response show detail.game.error as a gentle inline note (role='status' or 'alert') AND keep the existing final score visible (criterion 2 - never hide the score on failure).

Add CSS to frontend/src/styles.css: `.detail__linescore-scroll { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; max-width: 100%; }` and table styling that does NOT force the page to overflow (the scroll container absorbs the width). Ensure the rest of the detail page keeps the existing 375px no-horizontal-overflow guarantee: only the linescore table scrolls, inside its container. Verify against the existing layout/keyboard specs' 375px assumption.

Add a component test frontend/src/pages/SeriesDetailPage.test.tsx (or extend an existing detail test if present): render the page with a stubbed getBracket (use the existing final series fixture shape) and a mocked api.getGameDetail. Assert: (a) the accordion is collapsed by default and the final score is visible; (b) expanding calls getGameDetail once and renders the inning table (R/H/E), pitchers, and venue; (c) when getGameDetail rejects (or returns status:'unavailable'), the error note shows AND the final score remains visible (criterion 2); (d) the inning table is wrapped in an element with class detail__linescore-scroll (criterion 3). Mock @mlb/shared/api via vi.mock following the existing frontend test patterns.

Add/extend an e2e spec in frontend/e2e (e.g. extend detail.spec.ts or add game-detail-accordion.spec.ts). Add a stub helper in frontend/e2e/fixtures.ts: `stubGameDetail(page, body)` routing `**/game*` to a given GameDetailResponse, and a `stubGameDetailError(page)` routing it to a 500. Using the existing SAMPLE_2026_FINAL_SERIES_ID detail page: (1) expand a game accordion and assert the inning table + pitchers render (stub /game 'ok'); (2) stub /game to error and assert the inline error note shows while the final score (e.g. the existing game score text) stays visible (criterion 2); (3) at a 375px viewport assert the inning table's container (.detail__linescore-scroll) is horizontally scrollable (scrollWidth > clientWidth OR computed overflow-x is auto/scroll) and the page body does NOT overflow horizontally (criterion 3). Keep the existing detail.spec.ts assertions passing (the final-series detail page still renders the game-by-game list and back link).
Run frontend build + unit tests + e2e to confirm green and no regression to #22 keyboard, #18 favorites, #24 charts, #17/#20 UI, or the 375px no-overflow.
acceptance_criteria: Each game on the series detail page has an accessible accordion (aria-expanded/aria-controls) that is collapsed by default and lazy-fetches /game?gamePk= only on expand.
An expanded, successful panel shows the inning R/H/E table, W/L/S pitchers (save omitted when absent), venue, and an optional highlights link.
On a /game fetch failure or an 'unavailable' response, an inline error note shows AND the existing final score remains visible (criterion 2).
The inning table is wrapped in a horizontally-scrollable container (.detail__linescore-scroll) that scrolls at 375px without causing page-level horizontal overflow (criterion 3).
All new labels are localized EN/JA.
Frontend unit tests and e2e pass; existing detail/keyboard/favorites/charts specs still pass; `npm run build` passes.
findings: Done. Commit a3ff6f6 on feat/mlb-postseason-site (7 files, +846/-23). Implemented: (1) getGameDetail(gamePk) in frontend/src/api.ts via requestJson<GameDetailResponse> with NO seed fallback (throws ApiError so the component falls back to the final score). (2) Added 22 new detail.game.* i18n keys to BOTH the MessageKey union and the en+ja records (expand/collapse/loading/error, inning, R/H/E full+short, win/lose/save pitcher, venue, highlights, total, away/home). (3) Converted DetailGame <li> in SeriesDetailPage.tsx into an accessible accordion: a <button aria-expanded aria-controls> whose always-visible row keeps the final score line, plus a collapsible region panel. Lazy-fetch fires only on first expand; per-game state machine idle->loading->ready(ok)|fallback(error|unavailable). ready renders venue, W/L/S pitchers (save omitted when absent), optional highlight anchor (target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer), and the inning R/H/E <table> (scope=col header row with per-inning columns + R/H/E totals, two scope=row body rows) wrapped in <div class=detail__linescore-scroll>. loading uses role=status; error/unavailable uses role=status note while the score stays visible (criterion 2). (4) styles.css: .detail__linescore-scroll {overflow-x:auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch; max-width:100%} plus table/accordion styling so only the table scrolls and the 375px no-overflow guarantee holds. (5) e2e fixtures: SAMPLE_GAME_DETAIL_OK + stubGameDetail(page, body) + stubGameDetailError(page) routing **/game*. (6) Tests: frontend/src/pages/SeriesDetailPage.test.tsx (7 cases: collapsed-by-default/no-fetch, expand fetches once + renders table/pitchers/venue/highlight link, .detail__linescore-scroll wrapper, save omitted, reject fallback keeps score, unavailable fallback keeps score) and frontend/e2e/game-detail-accordion.spec.ts (ok render, error note keeps score, 375px scroll + no page overflow). Verification all green: npm run build OK; npm test 194 frontend + full suite pass; npm run test:e2e 49 passed incl. 3 new; npm run synth OK. Note: the cdk synth nodejs20.x deprecation WARNING is pre-existing from FEAT-003 and unrelated. frontend/dist is gitignored so not staged. Task-state dir left untracked per the repo's convention (committed later in a chore commit).
